about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Joachim, Confessor” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech You, almighty God, that by this sacrament which we have received, and by the interceding merits and prayers of blessed Joachim, father of the Mother of Your beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, we may be found worthy to share Your grace in the present life, and eternal glory in the life to come. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we may deserve to be partakers
